AboutPage.heroDesc: MediInfo.LK is a free, multilingual medicine information platform created to help Sri Lankan families make safer, more informed health decisions.
AboutPage.missionTitle: Making medicine information accessible to every Sri Lankan
AboutPage.missionP1: In Sri Lanka, access to clear, accurate medicine information has long been a challenge — especially for those who aren't fluent in English. MediInfo.LK was born to bridge that gap.
AboutPage.missionP2: Built by a team of passionate developers at Sabaragamuwa University under the name Pixel Pirates, our platform provides verified medicine details, dosage guides, side effect warnings, and trusted health articles in Sinhala, Tamil, and English.
AboutPage.missionP3: Our commitment is simple: every Sri Lankan deserves to understand their medicines — regardless of their language, location, or background.
AboutPage.valuesTitle: The principles that guide everything we do
AboutPage.valuesSubtitle: Our values shape the way we build, verify, and deliver health information to communities across Sri Lanka.
AboutPage.teamSubtitle: A group of dedicated students and developers committed to improving health literacy in Sri Lanka.
AboutPage.contactTitle: We'd love to hear from you
AboutPage.contactDesc: Whether you're a medical professional who wants to contribute, a user with feedback, or a partner interested in collaboration — reach out to us.
AboutPage.ctaTitle: Start exploring trusted medicine information today.
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Free, accurate, and available in your language.
AboutPage.teamDesc1: Leads architecture, development, and overall vision of MediInfo.LK.
AboutPage.teamDesc2: A passionate team of developers from Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka.
AboutPage.valueDesc1: Every medicine entry is reviewed and verified by licensed healthcare professionals before going live.
AboutPage.valueDesc2: We believe in a Sri Lanka where every citizen can access health information in their mother tongue.
AboutPage.valueDesc3: Built for Sri Lankan families — from rural villages to urban hospitals, our platform serves everyone.
AboutPage.valueDesc4: Harnessing AI and modern technology to make complex medical information simple and accessible.
AboutPage.valueDesc5: We collaborate with verified medical professionals to ensure our content is clinically sound.
AboutPage.valueDesc6: Empowering Sri Lankans with the knowledge to ask better questions and make safer health choices.
